sources.name: MMT Observatory all-sky camera
sources.licensing: Public download; no explicit reuse licence located
sources.archive_coverage: Dated raw directories verified through 2026-09-18; FITS archiving did not stop in June 2026
sources.access_note: Public directory listings expose cadence-selectable .fits.bz2 originals. Two nighttime originals were downloaded and inspected.

sources.name: University of Calgary TREx-RGB
sources.licensing: Open without authentication; citation is requested, but a reuse licence has not yet been identified
sources.access_note: Two official TREX_RGB_RAW_NOMINAL HDF5 bundles were downloaded and inspected. /data/images is uint8 RGB (480x553x3x20), so the public product does not meet the greater-than-8-bit requirement.

sources.name: PRESENTE / GOA-SCAN
sources.access_note: Published system descriptions establish 14-bit undemosaiced Bayer data in 16-bit HDF5 arrays, but the public site exposes rendered JPEGs and no public HDF5 route was located. Request raw access from GOA at angel@goa.uva.es.

sources.name: Rubin Observatory all-sky camera
sources.licensing: Public sample download; no explicit reuse licence located
sources.access_note: One verified nighttime CR2 is public in a two-file teaching set. The continuing USDF archive requires Rubin credentials and cannot support a public 20-minute cron feed.

sources.name: OASI all-sky camera
sources.access_note: The public pages document historical FITS acquisition, but the reachable current and historical products located were JPEG, PNG, or video; no original FITS file was found.

sources.name: Public INDI-AllSky installations
sources.access_note: Five independent public INDI-AllSky viewers were checked through their public image-viewer APIs. Each advertised JPEG/panorama products and returned null FITS/raw fields; no publicly exposed original was found.
